# CG-AUTH-006: Security scheme renamed

A security scheme was renamed with an identical definition.

**Why it matters:** Identical definitions authenticate identically.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `securityScheme.renamed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Security scheme "{from}" was renamed to "{to}".
>
> Scheme names are not sent on the wire.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: renamed with identical definition

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     ApiKeyAuth: {type: apiKey, name: K, in: header}
+     apiKey: {type: apiKey, name: K, in: header}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Security scheme "ApiKeyAuth" was renamed to "apiKey".

### Does not fire: definition changed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     ApiKeyAuth: {type: apiKey, name: K, in: header}
+     apiKey: {type: apiKey, name: Other, in: header}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
